description: This file defines the trait `ClientTrait` which provides HTTP client functionality for sending various HTTP requests (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, etc.) both synchronously and asynchronously. It includes abstract methods that need implementation, and concrete methods that utilize those abstract methods to perform specific HTTP actions.

methods.name: request
methods.description: Abstract method to create and send an HTTP request with specified method, URI, and options.

methods.description: Abstract method to create and send an asynchronous HTTP request with specified method, URI, and options.
